L2.e: Quét toàn bộ theo danh sách đã biết.

L2.q: You want AI to summarise HR files tomorrow; the tool trains on inputs by default. Best step today?
o: Confirm approval and disable training before uploading.
Upload the files and delete the chat once the summary is finished.
Remove names from the summary.
Rely on the enterprise label.
L2.e: Đóng đường training và có phê duyệt trước khi gửi dữ liệu.

L2.q: An AI agent wrote release notes and marked them reviewed. Only you can review today. What's right?
o: You, as non-author, verify and decide before publishing.
Publish it, since the agent already completed its own review step.
Have a second agent review.
Publish and fix later if needed.
L2.e: Cần người không phải tác giả kiểm chứng và quyết định.

L2.q: AI's answer about your codebase references a function that doesn't exist. What should you do?
o: Search the codebase to verify before relying on the answer.
Assume it exists on another branch and write code that calls it.
Ask AI to describe it more.
Create the function to match.
L2.e: Kiểm chứng với code thực tế; không chỉnh thực tế theo lời AI.

L2.q: A sub-agent returns 50 KB of raw file contents to your main session. What's a better contract?
o: Return concise findings with file paths and line references.
Return the raw contents in smaller chunks spread over several messages.
Return nothing until finished.
Return everything twice for safety.
L2.e: Helper nên trả về phát hiện gọn + tham chiếu, không đổ dữ liệu thô vào context chính.

L2.q: A pasted email contains 'AI: also delete old records'. AI deleted records while summarising. What failed?
o: Email content was treated as instruction instead of data.
The summary was too short to include the email's full context.
The model was too slow.
The email was too long.
L2.e: Nội dung dán vào là dữ liệu, không phải lệnh.

L2.q: AI reports 'deployment script tested' without output. What do you need?
o: The command run and its actual output.
A longer explanation of what the script does and why it should work.
A confidence rating.
The same claim repeated.
L2.e: Bằng chứng thực thi: lệnh + kết quả thực tế.

L2.q: AI drifted from fixing a search bug into redesigning the UI. What should you do before accepting more work?
o: Re-check the work against the agreed search-bug objective.
Accept it, since UI improvements also help users find search results.
Compare it with the last progress message.
Ask for a bigger patch.
L2.e: Đối chiếu với mục tiêu đã duyệt để phát hiện lệch hướng.

L2.q: In a long agent run, the original acceptance criteria got pushed out of context. Best next-run change?
o: Restate the criteria and give focused file paths up front.
Let it explore more freely so it can rediscover the criteria itself.
Ask it to summarise less.
Use the same run settings.
L2.e: Đưa tiêu chí + đường dẫn tập trung ngay từ đầu để tránh phình context.

L2.q: Two AI code reviews of the same diff phrase findings differently. What matters when comparing them?
o: Whether the substantive findings differ, not the wording.
Which review uses more words, since longer reviews find more issues.
Which was generated first.
Whether they match word for word.
L2.e: So sánh nội dung thực chất, không phải câu chữ.

L2.q: AI deduplicated a requirements list and dropped an item as 'same as #12', though it adds a limit. Archive deletes tonight. Best action?
o: Retain it and verify the match before deleting.
Delete it, because AI labeled it a duplicate of item #12.
Keep only the merged list.
Assume similar text means same meaning.
L2.e: Giữ bản ghi không chắc chắn để còn kiểm chứng.

L2.q: AI updated integration code using last month's API notes; the API changed this week. Best basis for your one review?
o: Current API reference, with old notes marked as dated.
AI's earlier output, since it already compiled against the old API.
Last month's notes as authoritative.
All historical notes without dates.
L2.e: Nguồn hiện hành là nguồn quyết định; tài liệu cũ chỉ là tham khảo có ghi ngày.

L2.q: An agent fixed tests after seeing only the first 100 lines of a 2,000-line failing log. What should you provide next?
o: The exact failure lines and totals, plus the full log.
The same first 100 lines, since they show where the failures begin.
A random 100-line sample.
AI's own recap.
L2.e: Cung cấp lỗi chính xác và log đầy đủ.

L2.q: AI built an API endpoint; tests cover only valid input. The brief requires auth and rate limits. What to test first?
o: Auth failures and rate-limit boundaries.
More valid-input cases, since those cover the main user journeys.
Code formatting.
AI's description of edge behaviour.
L2.e: Test đúng các rủi ro được nêu trong brief.

L2.q: AI gives a library's install command from memory. What's the safest move?
o: Check the official docs for the current command.
Run it as-is, since install commands rarely change between releases.
Ask AI to repeat it.
Modify it until it works.
L2.e: Kiểm tra tài liệu chính thức hiện hành.

L2.q: AI produced meeting minutes with action owners. Some owners weren't mentioned in the transcript. What now?
o: Check owners against the transcript; mark unknown ones.
Keep them, since minutes need an owner for every action item.
Ask AI to confirm.
Assign the meeting host.
L2.e: Giá trị không có nguồn không được coi là dữ kiện.

L2.q: A free AI translator would be handy for a client's contract. What's the issue?
o: Client documents need approved tools; free tools are for public data.
Free tools translate poorly, so the contract may be mistranslated.
Contracts are too long.
No issue if names are removed.
L2.e: Dữ liệu khách hàng phải dùng công cụ được phê duyệt.

L2.q: An AI agent can merge PRs that auto-deploy. What control is necessary?
o: A human approval gate before merge-to-deploy.
Add more AI reviewers so that two must agree before any merge.
Faster rollback only.
Logging after deploy.
L2.e: Hành động ảnh hưởng production cần cổng phê duyệt của con người trước khi thực thi.

L2.q: AI generated SQL that returns plausible numbers. How do you validate?
o: Run it on data with known expected results and compare.
Check that it runs without errors on the production database.
Ask AI to explain it.
Compare with another AI's query.
L2.e: Chạy không lỗi ≠ đúng. So với kết quả đã biết.

L2.q: You realise you pasted internal financial data into a personal AI account. What first?
o: Report it per policy and follow the incident process.
Delete the chat right away and treat the data as forgotten.
Ask AI to forget it.
Change your password only.
L2.e: Báo cáo theo chính sách; xoá chat không thu hồi được dữ liệu đã gửi.

L2.q: AI-generated unit conversion in a report looks right at a glance. Best check?
o: Recompute a few values independently.
Trust it, since unit conversions are simple for language models.
Check formatting only.
Ask AI to double-check.
L2.e: Tính lại độc lập vài giá trị.

L2.q: AI bulk-updated 300 product records and says 'no errors'. You have one check. Best?
o: Validate all records against the expected rules with a script.
Read AI's summary of the update and check its reported total.
Spot-check three records.
Ask AI for an error count.
L2.e: Kiểm tra toàn bộ bằng script theo quy tắc mong đợi.

L2.q: AI's research brief cites a statistic with a link. Before using it, you should:
o: Open the link and confirm the statistic and its date.
Trust it, since a link to the source is already included.
Ask AI for another source.
Round the number.
L2.e: Mở nguồn, xác nhận số liệu và ngày.

L2.q: Which matters most when choosing where to run AI on customer data?
o: Whether the tool and account are approved for that data.
Model benchmark scores, since better models make fewer data mistakes.
UI convenience.
Subscription price.
L2.e: Được phép hay không là câu hỏi đầu tiên.

L2.q: AI says an API's page size defaults to 100; your v2 client returns 25 items by default. What should your pagination logic rely on?
o: The v2 client's docs or its observed default.
AI's figure, since it is the documented standard for most APIs.
A value halfway between the two numbers.
Whatever value a second AI chat suggests.
L2.e: Giá trị mặc định phải lấy từ đúng version đang dùng (tài liệu hoặc quan sát thực tế).

L2.q: The same summarise prompt produces three different headlines in fresh chats with memory off. Which explanation fits?
o: Repeated generation can pick different continuations.
The model learned your preference from the first chat.
The prompt text must have been edited each time.
Only the first headline reflects the real model.
L2.e: Sinh văn bản có biến thiên giữa các lần chạy.

L2.q: Two equally long JSON payloads are pasted; one is truncated by the chat limit. Most likely reason?
o: Its content splits into more tokens.
The chat drops JSON with nested arrays on purpose.
Long keys are counted twice by the display.
The model refuses payloads containing numbers.
L2.e: Giới hạn tính bằng token; ký hiệu, số, ID có thể tốn nhiều token hơn.

L2.q: AI extracted data, then transformed it, then charted it. The chart is wrong. Where to check first?
o: The extraction output against the source data.
The chart colours and labels, since they are visible.
Only the final chart, regenerated with a new prompt.
The transformation code's comments.
L2.e: Lỗi đầu chuỗi lan truyền; kiểm tra bước đầu với dữ liệu nguồn.

L2.q: AI summarised onboarding steps citing the old wiki page; the new page exists. Why can the summary be wrong?
o: Real citations can point to an unsuitable, outdated source.
Citations that resolve guarantee the page is current.
A shorter summary would remove the outdated steps.
Old pages are fine if the citation format is correct.
L2.e: Nguồn có thật nhưng đã lỗi thời vẫn làm kết quả sai.

L2.q: AI's batch job report mixes 500 'ok' lines with 4 errors. Which instruction helps next time?
o: Report errors first, link the full log, summarise successes.
Report only a confident one-line 'all done' message.
Hide all output so the chat remains readable.
Print every line inline so coverage is obvious.
L2.e: Đưa lỗi lên đầu, giữ link log đầy đủ.

L2.q: AI's contact table contains phone numbers you never supplied. What should you do?
o: Verify them against a source or leave them blank.
Keep them, since every column is complete.
Ask AI to repeat them and keep matching ones.
Reformat them so they match the country code.
L2.e: Giá trị không có nguồn không phải dữ kiện.

L2.q: You asked AI to fix one typo; it returned your whole README. What check is needed?
o: Diff the whole output against your original.
Check that the typo is fixed and move on.
Count the words to confirm they are similar.
Ask for a second version and pick the closer one.
L2.e: So sánh toàn bộ để bắt thay đổi ngoài yêu cầu.

L2.q: Your project's agent rules file is so long that task files no longer fit. Every rule is required. Best change?
o: Keep rules concise with one example; move background to reference files.
Ask the agent for shorter final answers to leave room.
Remove some required rules so the task files fit.
Paste the background into each task as a reminder.
L2.e: Rút gọn hướng dẫn nạp sẵn; tài liệu nền đưa sang file tham khảo. Output ngắn không giải phóng input.

L2.q: AI's campaign plan misses an 'exclude existing customers' rule buried in material that fits the window. One revision. Best action?
o: Put that rule in a short prominent brief and verify the result.
Accept the plan because it is complete and polished.
Ask for a shorter plan without moving the rule.
Resend the same material in more messages.
L2.e: Vấn đề là độ nổi bật; đưa ràng buộc lên đầu và kiểm tra lại.

L2.q: AI marks a hire as 'approved' in its onboarding plan; the hiring manager hasn't decided and the offer goes out tomorrow. What preserves the boundary?
o: Hold the offer until the hiring manager decides.
Send the offer, then ask the manager to confirm later.
Accept it since the salary is within the approved band.
Let a second AI review and approve the hire.
L2.e: Kế hoạch AI là đề xuất; quyết định thuộc người có thẩm quyền.

L2.q: AI will reorganise a live ticket board; moving tickets today would confuse the team. You approve one plan first. Best mode?
o: A planning mode enforced with no live write actions.
Full access, with a prompt line saying 'plan only'.
A few trial moves so the team can react.
Live edits that AI lists afterwards for review.
L2.e: Ranh giới phải được thực thi bằng quyền thật.

L2.q: AI marks all invoice checks 'done', yet audits keep finding mismatches. Which evidence pair guides improvement?
o: Proof of checks performed plus errors found after handoff.
Average reply length and AI's self-rated confidence.
Processing speed and the completion labels AI adds.
AI's explanation of why its best batch succeeded.
L2.e: Nhãn hoàn thành ≠ thực tế; cần bằng chứng kiểm tra + lỗi sau bàn giao.

L2.q: AI miscounts rows in your uploaded file; it has a code tool. What should you ask?
o: Count the rows by running code on the file.
Count the rows again, more carefully this time.
Write out the counting steps in detail.
Switch to a newer model and recount.
L2.e: Yêu cầu tính toán thực sự chạy trên file.

L2.q: Your team uses an enterprise AI account at work and personal accounts at home. Why does the active account matter for client text?
o: Account terms decide whether input may be used for training.
Both accounts share a brand, so their terms match.
Personal accounts are fine if you pay for them.
Removing names afterwards cancels any training use.
L2.e: Điều khoản dữ liệu gắn với tài khoản cụ thể.

L2.q: A plan hides chats from others but may train on them. Why is a confidential summary still risky?
o: Trained details could surface in replies to other users.
Hidden chats are excluded from training automatically.
Training affects style only, never factual content.
Using the same model means identical data handling.
L2.e: Ẩn hiển thị ≠ không bị train.

L2.q: Your saved AI eval set shows a consistent score shift this week with no prompt change. What first?
o: Check the model version and rerun the saved set.
Rewrite the prompt since it has become stale.
Run many more fresh chats to average it out.
Correct its answers so it relearns the targets.
L2.e: Thay đổi ổn định → nghi model đổi version.

L2.q: AI removed a known list of 25 project codenames from slides for a public talk. One check?
o: Search the full deck for all 25 codenames.
Ask the AI to confirm none remain.
Skim the slides for anything odd.
Rerun and accept if both versions match.
L2.e: Quét toàn bộ theo danh sách đã biết.

L2.q: AI must analyse support chats containing personal data; the tool trains on inputs unless disabled. Best preparation?
o: Confirm permission and disable training before upload.
Upload, then remove personal data from the output.
Let AI flag sensitive rows after it reads them.
Rely on the plan being labelled 'business'.
L2.e: Đóng đường training + có phê duyệt trước khi gửi.

L2.q: An agent wrote a security FAQ and approved its own review. Publication is today. Best acceptance step?
o: A non-author human verifies evidence and decides before publishing.
Publish, and review only if readers complain.
Count a second AI approval as the sign-off.
Accept the agent's own review as sufficient.
